notes.title: First official release is coming!
notes.content:
I saw a lot of interest in Squaxel.
I never imagined it was possible for someone like me to get much exposure on my little game, but here it is...

Without further ado.

[h1]Squaxel V1.0 is coming![/h1]
[b]
What does it mean?[/b]
That Squaxel will no longer be in early access.

And because I don't want to leave you without informations about the next release, this is what is coming:
[list]
[*] New starting menu.
[*] New color scheme (already done in the Steam page of the game).
[*] The Arena Island (a place to farm XP)!
[*] Reworked some animations.
[*] The Candy Island.
[*] Max level is now 25.
[*] [b]And a lot more that I will not spoil...[/b]
[/list]

So stay tuned for the first big update of the game!
